statusLegend.ready: Works once installed. No key or paid plan needed.
statusLegend.needs-key: Needs an API key, sign-in or credits before first use.
statusLegend.dormant: Wired. Needs a paid plan before it does anything.
statusLegend.on-demand: Needs a local app or server running.
statusLegend.library: No MCP. Install the package in the project that needs it.
statusLegend.tool: A web or desktop app, used by hand.

tools.name: GSAP
tools.what: The animation engine. Timelines, ScrollTrigger, SplitText, MorphSVG, Flip, all plugins now free.
tools.when: Any choreographed motion: scroll stories, pinned sections, text reveals, sequenced intros.
tools.agentAccess: greensock/gsap-skills plugin (official skills, no MCP exists)
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Lenis
tools.what: Smooth scroll that keeps native scroll semantics. Pairs with GSAP ScrollTrigger.
tools.when: Long-form scroll pages where inertia sells the feel. Skip on dashboards and docs.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: Motion (motion.dev)
tools.what: React/JS animation with springs, layout animation and gestures. Formerly Framer Motion.
tools.when: UI state transitions, layout shifts, enter/exit, gesture-driven components.
tools.agentAccess: motion MCP (https://mcp.motion.dev) + motion skill; Motion+ sign-in unlocks audits
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Scroll World
tools.what: Agent skill that turns a brand into a scrollable 3D-world landing page.
tools.when: A launch or brand page where the scroll itself is the product tour.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: ScrollCraft
tools.what: Skill for premium scroll-driven landing pages: scrubbed video, pinned sections, one signature move.
tools.when: Photographic, cinematic landing pages. Starts with an 8-question interview.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: three.js
tools.what: The 3D library of the web. R3F wraps it for React.
tools.when: Any real-time 3D: product viewers, hero scenes, data in space.
tools.agentAccess: threejs-* skills (10) + webgpu-threejs-tsl skill; Context7 for docs
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: img2threejs
tools.what: Skill that rebuilds an object from a reference image as a procedural, animation-ready three.js model.
tools.when: You have a photo of an object and want it as code, not a downloaded GLB.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Threlte
tools.what: three.js for Svelte, declarative and typed.
tools.when: The project is SvelteKit.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: ThreeUI
tools.what: Library of three.js landing pages, hero sections, scenes, backgrounds and buttons by Design+Code. Community edition is MIT; Pro adds source, CLI and MCP.
tools.when: You need a ready 3D UI element (orbs, cards, globes) rather than a scene from scratch.
tools.agentAccess: ThreeUI MCP (remote HTTP, https://threeui.com/api/mcp, OAuth; Pro only: $199/yr or $299 lifetime)
tools.needs: a paid plan

tools.name: Spline
tools.what: Browser/desktop 3D design tool with exportable interactive scenes.
tools.when: A designed 3D moment that is faster to model by hand than in code.
tools.install: Spline desktop app; its MCP is bundled with the app
tools.agentAccess: Spline MCP (local, bundled with the app): 3d_* tools drive the 3D editor, 2d_* drive Hana. Keep the app open.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: PlayCanvas
tools.what: WebGL/WebGPU game engine with a collaborative editor.
tools.when: Game-like interactive 3D, or when the scene should be edited visually by a team.
tools.needs: a local app or server running

tools.name: Vectary
tools.what: No-code 3D and AR design in the browser. (Logged from 'Vectory.com': vectory.com is a sensor company.)
tools.when: Quick product mockups and AR embeds without code.
tools.needs: nothing; a web or desktop app used by hand

tools.name: OGL
tools.what: Tiny WebGL library. This site's hero shader runs on it.
tools.when: A full-screen shader or a light 2D/3D effect where three.js is overkill.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: ShaderGradient
tools.what: Moving 3D gradients for React, Framer and Figma, tuned in a visual editor.
tools.when: A living gradient background without writing GLSL.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: GetLayers
tools.what: Library of prompts plus source for templates, 3D/WebGL scenes, motion sections and animated backgrounds.
tools.when: Design-led landing pages that need a premium background, scene or motion section fast.
tools.agentAccess: https://mcp.getlayers.ai/mcp, OAuth on first use; MCP only on the $199 Full Stack plan
tools.needs: a paid plan

tools.name: Higgsfield
tools.what: One MCP for many image, video, audio and 3D models: stills, image-to-video, motion transfer, upscaling, background removal, image-to-GLB.
tools.when: Hero stills, ambient background loops, product shots, turning an object into a 3D model. Approve a still before animating it.
tools.install: Add the Higgsfield connector in claude.ai (Settings, Connectors)
tools.agentAccess: Higgsfield MCP (claude.ai connector); runs on credits
tools.needs: an API key, sign-in or credits

tools.name: React Bits
tools.what: Animated React components with live prop controls, in JS/TS × CSS/Tailwind variants.
tools.when: Text effects, backgrounds and animated UI pieces you want to own the code of.
tools.agentAccess: shadcn MCP with the @react-bits registry (per project)
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Magic UI
tools.what: Motion-first shadcn-style components for landing pages.
tools.when: Marketing sections: marquees, bento grids, animated beams, number tickers.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Cult UI
tools.what: shadcn-compatible animated components with character.
tools.when: Distinctive interactive pieces (dynamic island, texture buttons, shift cards).
tools.agentAccess: shadcn MCP with the @cult-ui registry (per project)
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: 21st.dev
tools.what: Community component catalogue plus AI UI generation.
tools.when: Searching for a component pattern across many authors, or generating a first draft of one.
tools.agentAccess: 21st MCP; search is free, get_component/generate are paid
tools.needs: an API key, sign-in or credits

tools.name: Bklit UI
tools.what: UI and chart components shipped as a shadcn registry.
tools.when: Dashboards and analytics views that need good-looking charts fast.
tools.agentAccess: shadcn MCP with the @bklit registry (per project)
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: shadcn/ui
tools.what: Copy-in component system and the registry protocol most libraries above ship through.
tools.when: The base layer of any React app. Also the way to install from every @registry.
tools.install: npx shadcn@latest init && npx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude
tools.agentAccess: shadcn MCP, configured per project (needs components.json)
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Refero
tools.what: Searchable library of real app and web screens, flows and styles.
tools.when: Before designing a flow: see how the best products solved the same screen.
tools.agentAccess: https://api.refero.design/mcp, sign in with a paid plan
tools.needs: an API key, sign-in or credits

tools.name: Jitter
tools.what: Web motion-design tool for animating UI and exporting video/Lottie.
tools.when: Prototyping a motion idea before coding it, or making a launch video of the UI.
tools.needs: nothing; a web or desktop app used by hand

tools.name: Paper
tools.what: Design canvas with a local MCP. Useful to scope ideas.
tools.when: Scoping a layout visually before building.
tools.install: Paper desktop app; its MCP runs at http://127.0.0.1:29979/mcp while the app is open
tools.needs: a local app or server running

tools.name: frontend-design (official)
tools.what: Anthropic's skill for distinctive, non-templated visual direction.
tools.when: The first pass on any new UI.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: impeccable
tools.what: Design language and audit skill: critique, polish, harden, animate, colourise.
tools.when: Auditing and polishing a UI that already exists.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: taste-skill
tools.what: design-taste-frontend, high-end-visual-design and redesign-existing-projects: anti-generic rules.
tools.when: Landing pages and portfolios that must not look AI-made.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: UI/UX Pro Max
tools.what: Searchable database of 79 styles, 192 palettes and 74 font pairings.
tools.when: Exploring directions early. Treat its output as a starting point, not a finish.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Web Interface Guidelines
tools.what: Rauno/Vercel's MUST/SHOULD interface rules as a review skill, plus React best practices, composition patterns and view transitions.
tools.when: Reviewing any UI before it ships.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Anthropic example skills
tools.what: canvas-design, theme-factory, algorithmic-art, web-artifacts-builder, brand-guidelines, webapp-testing.
tools.when: Posters and static visuals, themes, generative art, quick artifacts.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: frontend-design-basics
tools.what: Reads this toolkit and the Principles chapter, then asks which tools and principles fit the brief.
tools.when: Automatically, at the start of every new project or design task.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Context7
tools.what: Current, versioned library docs on demand (GSAP, three.js, Lenis, Next.js…).
tools.when: Any time an API might have changed since the model's training.
tools.install: claude mcp add -s user --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.what: Drive a real browser: screenshots, frames, interaction.
tools.when: Proving motion with frames ~1.5 s apart, checking mobile widths, capturing showcase shots.
tools.install: claude mcp add -s user playwright -- npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.what: Performance traces, console, network from a live Chrome.
tools.when: Animation jank, layout thrash, slow loads.
tools.install: claude mcp add -s user chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line

tools.name: VoiceStudio
tools.what: Local, open-source voice cloning, TTS, dubbing and transcription.
tools.when: Narration for a launch film or an interactive voice on a site. Runs locally, no key.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio and follow its README
tools.needs: a local app or server running

tools.name: OpenWA
tools.what: Self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway with a built-in MCP.
tools.when: Reading WhatsApp data into a tool. Kept read-only: nothing is ever sent from it.
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/rmyndharis/OpenWA and follow its README
tools.agentAccess: its own MCP at http://localhost:2785/mcp, read-only tools recommended
tools.needs: a local app or server running

tools.name: Unicorn Studio
tools.what: A visual editor for WebGL scenes: layered shaders, media, 3D and mouse or scroll interaction, published as an embed.
tools.when: A showpiece shader hero or background you want to tune by eye, not in GLSL.
tools.install: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/hiunicornstudio/unicornstudio.js/dist/unicornStudio.umd.js"> then UnicornStudio.init() on a data-us-project div
tools.agentAccess: No MCP. Agents can read unicorn.studio/unicornstudio-llms.txt (as data).
tools.needs: nothing; a web or desktop app used by hand
tools.cost: free plan (logo, non-commercial); Legend $20/mo for commercial + self-hosting

tools.name: Paper Shaders
tools.what: Ready-made, tunable shader components for React: mesh gradients, grain, dithering, liquid metal.
tools.when: A good-looking shader background in minutes, with props instead of GLSL.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: View Transition API
tools.what: The browser animates between two DOM states or two pages: crossfades and shared-element morphs with CSS.
tools.when: Page-to-page or state-to-state transitions without a library; fall back to a plain swap where unsupported.
tools.install: built into the browser: document.startViewTransition(() => update())
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: Anime.js v4
tools.what: A small animation engine with timelines, springs, SVG morphing, draggables and scroll-linked animation.
tools.when: A lighter alternative to GSAP for a small site, or when you like its API.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: dotLottie
tools.what: Plays After Effects and Lottie Creator animations on the web, small and crisp at any size.
tools.when: Icon animations, onboarding illustrations and loaders that a designer animated by hand.
tools.agentAccess: Lottie Creator has an MCP (LottieFiles account needed)
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)
tools.cost: free player; Creator has paid plans

tools.name: Taxi.js
tools.what: Page transitions for multi-page sites: fetches the next page and lets you animate out and in.
tools.when: Smooth transitions on a static or CMS site that is not a single-page app.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: Motion Primitives
tools.what: Copy-paste animated React components built on Motion: text effects, morphing dialogs, carousels.
tools.when: You want polished micro-interactions that drop into a shadcn project.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: Lucide
tools.what: A clean, consistent open icon set with a React package; the shadcn default.
tools.when: Interface icons. One set per project.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: postprocessing
tools.what: Full-screen effects after a three.js scene renders: bloom, pixelation, chromatic split, depth of field.
tools.when: Any 3D piece that needs a finish: glow, grain, a pixel look.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: Tweakpane
tools.what: A small panel of sliders and pickers for tuning values live while you build.
tools.when: Dialling in eases, colours and shader uniforms by eye.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)

tools.name: OKLCH Color Picker
tools.what: A colour picker in OKLCH, the colour space where equal steps look equal.
tools.when: Building a palette or ramp that stays even in lightness.
tools.needs: nothing; a web or desktop app used by hand

tools.name: Fontshare
tools.what: Free, quality typefaces from Indian Type Foundry, with web embeds.
tools.when: Picking a typeface that is not an AI default.
tools.needs: nothing; a web or desktop app used by hand
tools.cost: free for personal and commercial use (check each licence)

tools.name: easings.net + cubic-bezier.com
tools.what: Reference charts of every standard ease, and an editor for your own cubic-bezier curves.
tools.when: Choosing or designing an ease.
tools.needs: nothing; a web or desktop app used by hand

tools.name: Poly Haven
tools.what: Free HDRIs, textures and 3D models to light and dress a three.js scene.
tools.when: Realistic lighting (an HDRI) or a material without making your own.
tools.needs: nothing beyond the install line (a package, no MCP)
